name: capgo-organization-management
description: >- Guides Capgo account lookup and organization administration with the CLI, including `account whoami`, `organization list/add/members/set/delete`, 2FA enforcement, password policy, API-key expiration and hashed-key policy, and apps per organization. Use when listing or creating Capgo organizations, auditing members' 2FA before enforcing it, tightening org security settings, or resolving "Access Denied: Two-Factor Authentication Required" or "Insufficient permissions". Do not use for OTA bundle
author: Cap-go
